in_sanskrit.name: असव:
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'असव:' (Asav) is derived from the prefix 'अस-' (as) which means 'not' and the suffix 'व-' (v) which denotes absence. It can be interpreted as 'absence of', 'not present', or 'lack of'. In Hindu mythology, the demon Asura (असुर) is also called Asava (असव) because he was the embodiment of 'asav' or absence of divine qualities.

in_hindi.name: असव:
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name 'असव:' (Asav) is derived from the Sanskrit word 'असव:' (Asav). It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit, i.e., 'absence of', 'not present', or 'lack of'. In Hindi, the word 'अभाव' (abhāv) and 'असत' (asat) are synonyms of 'असव:' (Asav).

in_tamil.name: அசவ்:
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'அசவ்:' (Asav) is derived from the Tamil words 'அவ்வாறு' (avvāṟu) and 'அவோடு' (avōdu), which mean 'other side' and 'absent', respectively. Together, they can be interpreted as 'absence from the other side' or 'not present'. This name might have been influenced by the Sanskrit word 'असव:' (Asav).

in_telugu.name: అశవ్:
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'అశవ్:' (Asav) is derived from the Sanskrit word 'असव:' (Asav). It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit, i.e., 'absence of', 'not present', or 'lack of'. In Telugu, the words 'అప్రధ్య' (apradhy) and 'అసత' (asat) are synonyms of 'అశవ్:' (Asav).

in_marathi.name: Asav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, the name Asav translates to 'free from'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘as’ meaning ‘free from’ and ‘av’ meaning ‘affliction’. This name is associated with the God Ashtavakra, who was born free from the physical and mental afflictions.
